context: DOC-E current evidence generation for commit db52f9f... on GitHub Actions.
symptom: Jobs completed/failure with steps=null; checkout/commands never ran; some log retrieval returned BlobNotFound.
root_cause: Hosted runner/environment failure before test execution.
failed_approach: Treat workflow completion/failure status as if application tests executed.
why_failed: No application command actually ran, so workflow outcome cannot prove PASS/FAIL of NEXY behavior.
successful_recovery: Preserve BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT; rerun on a functioning hosted/isolated runner and bind evidence to exact HEAD.
prevention: Never infer application verdict from a job that has no executed steps.
Evidence must include exact commit and executable command output.

context: Current branch observed at 9c9befd9fe255b0f9271e6e2b8c4bb2443a08089; DOC-E E1–E12 declare db52f9f...
symptom: Evidence artifacts exist but are revision-stale for current HEAD.
root_cause: Evidence freshness mismatch.
failed_approach: Reuse older evidence because file name is under docs/evidence/current/.
why_failed: Directory name does not change artifact commit binding.
successful_recovery: Mark historical/stale and regenerate exact-head evidence.
prevention: Evidence Registry must compare reported commit with observed HEAD before verdict.

symptom: LAW release gate returns passed=false; run becomes FREEZE/REJECTED and incident/audit are recorded.
root_cause: One or more release invariants fail: acceptance, deterministic threshold, quorum, critical-agent state, LAW check/evidence.
failed_approach: Commit final output before LAW authorization or convert rejection into warning.
why_failed: Would violate verified-output-only and one-output/freeze law.
successful_recovery: RecordPipelineRunFailure, complete dispatch, preserve incident/audit, return REJECTED; fix underlying proof/consensus cause then start a new legal run.
prevention: Final durable output must not exist before LAW passes.

symptom: SchemaViolationError / SCHEMA_VIOLATION.
root_cause: Queue payload does not conform to canonical DirectiveJobSchema or producer idempotency key mismatches.
failed_approach: Trust producer data because it came from internal code.
why_failed: DOC-C requires revalidation at producer and consumer trust boundaries.
successful_recovery: Reject job, record run failure/incident/audit if run exists; do not retry malformed payload.
prevention: Validate before enqueue and again before consume.

symptom: Job throws [EXPIRED] after stale_job_ttl_ms.
root_cause: Enqueued job age exceeded configured stale-job TTL.
failed_approach: Execute stale job to maximize availability.
why_failed: Could apply obsolete work after state/context changed.
successful_recovery: Expire/fail job; preserve failure visibility and require fresh execution cycle.
prevention: Use same enqueue-time clock basis at queue boundary; keep TTL canonical.

symptom: REDIS_AOF_DISABLED causes CRITICAL WORKER_DOWN alarm and process exit.
root_cause: Redis persistence is not configured appendonly=yes.
failed_approach: Run worker on non-durable Redis.
why_failed: Could acknowledge/lose queue state contrary to durability boundary.
successful_recovery: Do not start worker; enable durable Redis AOF and restart under verified config.
prevention: Worker startup must assert Redis durability before consuming.

symptom: Duplicate job is acknowledged as CANCELLED or already completed instead of re-running swarm.
root_cause: Dispatch record is already processing/completed.
failed_approach: Re-run duplicate delivery.
why_failed: Would violate one-event/idempotency semantics and may duplicate side effects.
successful_recovery: Return prior/completed outcome or cancel duplicate; never execute swarm twice for same dispatch identity.
prevention: Claim dispatch atomically before work.

symptom: Persistence of mandatory incident/audit evidence itself fails; worker emits MANDATORY_AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_FAILURE.
root_cause: Database/transaction failure while recording required safety evidence.
failed_approach: Downgrade missing audit evidence to optional telemetry.
why_failed: Safety evidence is mandatory and absence destroys accountability.
successful_recovery: Keep failure visible/frozen; do not convert to success; restore DB then reconcile from durable dispatch/run state.
prevention: Mandatory safety records must be transactional; optional alarm delivery stays secondary.

symptom: In-memory FREEZE exists without FreezeIncident/AuditLog linkage.
root_cause: Caller used buildFreezeEnvelope without required SERIALIZABLE persistence transaction.
failed_approach: Assume helper persists incident automatically.
why_failed: freeze.ts explicitly does not persist incident/audit; caller owns it.
successful_recovery: Create/link FreezeIncident + AuditLog transactionally; treat missing linkage as failed safety invariant.
prevention: Every production FREEZE caller must persist mandatory evidence.

symptom: STATE_TRANSITION_DENIED or actor ownership violation.
root_cause: Event not legal from current state or actor does not own event.
failed_approach: Force state assignment to reach desired state.
why_failed: Bypasses explicit state law and audit semantics.
successful_recovery: Reject transition; preserve current state; handle through legal event/recovery or FREEZE.
prevention: All state changes go through single FSM driver.

symptom: Recovery denied because reason is non-recoverable or actor not OWNER/SYSTEM as allowed.
root_cause: Freeze reason catalog/authorization guard rejects recovery.
failed_approach: Force READY or mutate DB state directly.
why_failed: Would erase causal failure and violate deterministic operational authority.
successful_recovery: Keep FREEZE; resolve root cause or use authorized recovery only when reason catalog permits.
prevention: Recovery eligibility and actor are explicit data, not operator discretion.

symptom: VAULT_COMMIT_CONFLICT / optimistic concurrency conflict.
root_cause: previous_version or revision sequence no longer matches current artifact state.
failed_approach: Overwrite latest revision or retry with stale expected version.
why_failed: Would destroy append-only lineage and concurrent-write correctness.
successful_recovery: Reload current version, create legal new revision, retry with new idempotency/version context.
prevention: Unique revision numbering + previous_version OCC + idempotency.

symptom: Expired/reused/device-mismatched/brute-forced OTAC is denied and may emit security incident/alarm.
root_cause: Auth token lifetime/use/attempt/device constraints violated.
failed_approach: Allow fallback login or reuse consumed OTAC.
why_failed: Would bypass authentication law.
successful_recovery: Deny session creation, consume/revoke state as applicable, audit incident; user requests a new legal OTAC.
prevention: Hash OTAC at rest, enforce single use/TTL/attempt/cooldown/device semantics.

context: Session creation with max concurrent sessions reached.
symptom: Oldest non-OWNER session is revoked; if all active sessions are OWNER and new OWNER requested, SESSION_CAP_REACHED/SESSION_REVOKED error.
root_cause: Concurrent session cap is exhausted.
failed_approach: Silently evict OWNER session or exceed cap.
why_failed: Would violate explicit owner-session protection/current limits.
successful_recovery: Revoke legal non-owner candidate or deny new owner session until explicit action.
prevention: Deterministic oldest non-owner eviction policy.

symptom: Internal alarm emission passes but external delivery is BLOCKED_NO_BOUND_NEXY_MONITORING_PLATFORM.
root_cause: No external monitoring sink is bound.
failed_approach: Claim observability deployment readiness from in-memory alarm buffer.
why_failed: Internal emission does not prove external monitoring delivery.
successful_recovery: Keep BLOCKED_EXTERNAL; bind approved monitoring adapter and exercise exact-head delivery.
prevention: Alarm delivery is optional observability and never substitutes mandatory EventLog/AuditLog.

symptom: No authorized engineering/security/migration signoffs; PR remains DRAFT/NON_DEPLOYABLE.
root_cause: External human authorization is absent.
failed_approach: Generate an AI approval checkbox or infer signoff from passing code.
why_failed: Would fabricate external authority.
successful_recovery: Remain BLOCKED_EXTERNAL until authorized signoffs are supplied for exact release.
regression_test: release gate checks required signoff artifact
prevention: AI must never fabricate human authorization.

symptom: Current migration forward/rollback/forward did not run because isolated PostgreSQL Actions job had steps=null.
root_cause: Execution environment unavailable.
failed_approach: Reuse older roundtrip as proof for newer atomic-release migration.
why_failed: Migration proof is schema/revision-specific.
successful_recovery: Rerun exact current migration/rollback in isolated DB and retain logs.
prevention: Migration/rollback evidence must bind exact schema revision.

symptom: Real Redis/BullMQ/PostgreSQL producer+worker gate did not execute on current revision.
root_cause: Hosted isolated runner failed before services/steps.
failed_approach: Use prior run that produced FREEZE,FREEZE as current success-path proof.
why_failed: Prior run is older revision and did not establish current successful queue path.
successful_recovery: Rerun current exact-head E7 with durable Redis AOF + PostgreSQL + actual worker.
prevention: Do not promote configured queue code to runtime readiness without real service exercise.

symptom: Crash count reaches configured loop limit and runtime switches to SAFE_RUNTIME; directives become unacceptable.
root_cause: Repeated process failures within crash window.
failed_approach: Continue normal execution after repeated crashes.
why_failed: Could amplify corruption/resource failure.
successful_recovery: Enter SAFE_RUNTIME, stop ordinary directives, investigate/recover under guarded path.
prevention: Bound crash retries and escalate mode.

symptom: Memory ratio > 0.92 triggers pre-death seal and process exit.
root_cause: Critical OOM risk.
failed_approach: Keep process alive until OOM kill without WAL/event sealing.
why_failed: Could lose final state/evidence and corrupt recovery boundary.
successful_recovery: Flush registered WALs, seal final event hash, record reason, exit; restart only after integrity check.
prevention: Monitor cgroup/proc memory and pre-seal before death.

symptom: Persisted final event hash does not equal current WAL hash.
root_cause: Restart state does not match sealed pre-death history.
failed_approach: Ignore mismatch to restore availability.
why_failed: Would resurrect divergent/corrupt state.
successful_recovery: Do not resume normal runtime; remain safe/frozen and require verified recovery.
prevention: Bind recovery to exact state/build/environment hashes.

symptom: Playbook attempts exceed escalateAfterAttempts and result becomes ESCALATED.
root_cause: Repeated remediation failure.
failed_approach: Retry forever.
why_failed: Unbounded recovery loop hides persistent defect and consumes resources.
successful_recovery: Escalate to owner; keep recovery history; require explicit intervention or new governed playbook.
prevention: Bound remediation attempts and reset count only on success.
